title: Finite typed functor expressions, prescribed comparisons and paired contextual transformations
statement: Let $S,J$ be sets, $s:J\to S$, and let $\mathcal C_a,\mathcal D_a$ be categories [def-nagata-category], with specified adjoint equivalences $E_a=(R_a,L_a,u_a,e_a)$. Choose sets of unary symbols $U(a,b)$ and binary symbols $B(a,b,c)$, interpreted by functors $A:\mathcal D_a\to\mathcal D_b$, $B:\mathcal D_a\times\mathcal D_b\to\mathcal D_c$, independently specified barred functors on the $\mathcal C$ categories, and natural isomorphisms $d_A:L_b A R_a\cong\bar A$, $d_B:L_c B(R_a-,R_b-)\cong\bar B$. Define finite typed expressions by inputs $i:J$, unary application and binary application, retaining all parentheses and permitting repeated inputs. Evaluate them as functors on whole families of $\mathcal D$ inputs and independently on $\mathcal C$ inputs; reduction of an input family is $(RK)_i=R_{s(i)}K_i$. Set $a_A(M)=d_A(LM)(LA(e_M))^{-1}$ and $a_B(M,N)=d_B(LM,LN)(LB(e_M,e_N))^{-1}$. Define recursively $c_i=u_{K_i}^{-1}$, $c_{AV}=\bar A(c_V)a_A(M_V)$, $c_{B(V,T)}=\bar B(c_V,c_T)a_B(M_V,M_T)$, where $M_V=V(RK)$, and $r_V=e_{M_V}R(c_V^{-1})$. For expressions $V,T$ of the same output, define paired transformations to be the inductively generated relation on independently specified natural transformations $h:V\to T$, $k:\bar V\to\bar T$: generators are precisely pairs satisfying $h_{RK}r_V=r_TR(k_K)$ for every input family $K$; close under identities, composition, simultaneous inverse of isomorphisms, unary whiskering and binary whiskering in both slots. Unchanged slots use identities, and repeated holes may use the same pair more than once. No category, input set or symbol set is required to be nonempty.
